question: When {A4} completely disappears from view A, where is {B1} located relative to {B4} in view B?

observed_information.statement: A4 is visible in view A during 0.0-4.0s at the bottom right.
A4 is visible in view A during 6.0-8.0s at the bottom left edge.
B1 appears in view B at 4.0s.
B4 is visible throughout the 0.0-8.0s v2 event.
During 0.0-8.0s, B1 is positioned to the left of B4.

working_relations.statement: A4 in v1 and B4 in v2 denote the same annotated physical track, so view-A timing can be aligned to view-B using the shared clock.
The reference sidecar distinguishes the view-A disappearance endpoint of A4 at 8.533s from the view-B visibility endpoint of B4 at 9.300s.
Both supplied event reports stop at 8.0s, before the 8.533s synchronized trigger time, so the target B1-to-B4 state is not directly covered by the events.
